observed_failure: The corrected application semaphore no longer blocked every recovery case, but the harness still configured recovery Worker Activity concurrency as 16 instead of the frozen value 8. At fan-out 32, outage Activities retained all Worker slots while waiting for global backlog completion and one timed out. Concurrent layered-retry work also produced a heartbeat retry in an unfaulted arm, exceeding the request bound.
inference: The v2 root is invalid harness evidence and does not support a topology conclusion. Global backlog coordination must not retain a scarce Activity slot, and Worker Activity concurrency must remain exactly eight.
disposition: Raw run directories are retained unchanged. The corrected procedure must be shared by the direct and Child arms and written to a new root.
